answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The dawn of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. A spiral of per-task receipts records who did what, and the meadow of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
